final_assessment:
COVERAGE RECORD for the FIRST of two external-proposal files from one reviewer's iteration 1. Both files are GPT-5 Codex reviewing the same tree; 02-21-43Z is a sharpened re-run and a strict superset (it adds one WARNING and sharpens three titles). The substantive walk is recorded against 02-21-43Z; every edit it describes is in the tree.

This record exists because resolution is keyed on (title, file) and the two files title the same defects differently — so without it, a pass whose findings are genuinely and completely resolved would read as carrying unresolved substantive findings, and the gate would hold on a defect that no longer exists. That is the inverse of Q-crc-17's failure (a record certifying nothing while claiming ten resolutions): here the work is done and the record would have claimed nothing.

One thing this file caught that its re-run did not state as sharply: the generated apply/archive REFERENCES repeat the old membership definition while the tasks changed only cardinality. That half is why tasks 2.1b and 2.2a now carry two edits each rather than one.

Worth knowing before reading the spend figure: the trail now counts THREE independent passes (one fresh, two external files) for what is substantively two reviews. A reviewer that re-runs rather than editing in place inflates recorded spend, and nothing distinguishes a re-run from a genuinely independent second pass at the trail level.
